newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber unchanged in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber unchanged in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were unchanged in late trading on Thursday as buying interest remained thin, traders said.
Traders said a deal was done at 47.75 U.S. cents/lb in Banjarmasin for July shipment, but most traders in other cities were reluctant to sell at such low prices.
"I learn that a deal was done in Banjarmasin and that traders lowered their offer prices in Surabaya to 48.00 for June shipment," said one trader.
"Offer prices in other cities, however, stayed the same because traders do not want to sell," he added.
Traders said SIR20 was unchanged at 48.50 in Medan.
Offer prices were unchanged at 48.25 fob Palembang, at 48.00 fob Padang and at 47.75 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
"There's nothing shocking in the market as everything is quiet ahead of tomorrow's holiday," said another trader.
The market is closed on Friday for the Moslem Eid al-Adha celebration.
